scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind understanding email.
Recipient: is the person meant to receive an email. Subject: says briefly what the message is about.
Message body: contains the main written information. Attachment: is a file sent with a message. Reply: sends a response to a received message.
Use an imaginary example or a teacher-approved offline screenshot. Discuss when to use recipient and subject. Never enter a real password or share private details in this activity.
